transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you and what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’ve kind of stopped caring about things. I don’t mean to sound dramatic, sorry. It’s just… I used to like my art classes, board-game nights, hiking, even trying to get back on the soccer team, and now I just don’t really feel anything about them. I mostly sit in my room and let everything kind of slip away.
How long have you been feeling this way, like you don’t care about things anymore?

It’s been… longer than I probably want to admit. It started getting really constant around the summer after that, and it’s been about a year and four months now. I kept thinking it would pass, so I didn’t want to make a big deal of it, but… yeah, it’s been that long.
Do you find that you feel sad or down most of the time, or have trouble feeling pleasure in most activities, even the ones you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I think that’s probably the main thing. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but I just don’t really feel pleasure in things anymore. Like art classes, board-game nights, hiking… even the idea of getting back on the soccer team, which I used to care about. I mostly just stay in my room and kind of let everything slip. Is that… the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep or appetite, or do you find yourself feeling more irritable or guilty than usual?

Um… sleep, yeah. It’s not great. I mean, I do sleep eventually, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’m not sleeping at all, but I’ll lie awake for hours checking the door and listening for… I don’t know, noises, I guess. Then when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up really early, before dawn, shaking, and I can’t really get back under. Is that the kind of change you mean?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently? Like if you're eating less or have lost weight without trying?

Yeah… I guess I have been eating less. I don’t mean to, exactly. I just go most of the day without eating because food kind of tastes like cardboard, and then I’ll realize it’s late and I haven’t really had anything. My jeans have gotten really loose too… like, loose enough that I’ve been knotting the waistband, but I didn’t want to make a big deal out of it. Is that what you mean?
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety in a way that others might notice?

Yeah… I mean, maybe a little of both? I don’t know if it’s noticeable to other people, but some days I catch myself pacing from the kitchen to the window over and over until my legs actually ache. And then other times I’m just… so slow. Like making coffee feels weirdly heavy, like I’m lifting wet cement or something. I’m sorry if that sounds dramatic—does that answer it?
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or thought about hurting yourself?

I… I don’t want to scare you or make it sound worse than it is, but yes, I’ve had thoughts like… I don’t want to wake up anymore. Not exactly like I’m trying to be dramatic, just that it feels like too much.

And my friend… when they found me, I guess I was saying out loud that I couldn’t keep living like this. I’m sorry, is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt this way for weeks or months at a time?

Um… yeah. I think so. It wasn’t just a few bad days.

It kind of became constant around the following summer, if I’m remembering right… and it’s been going on since then. So… maybe about a year and four months now. I know that sounds like a long time. I guess I kept thinking it would lift on its own, so I didn’t really count it that way until now.
Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, did you have another time when you felt this way for a long enough period that it was noticeable in your daily life?

I’m not sure there was a separate one before this, honestly. It more… became constant around the following summer, and it’s kind of just stayed that way since then. So I guess it’s been about a year and four months.

I’m sorry, I know that’s maybe not exactly answering “before,” but I don’t really remember another distinct period like that before this one.
Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, did you ever have another time when you felt this way for at least two weeks or more?

I don’t think there was a separate time before this one, not that I can clearly remember. It’s more like… it became steady around the following summer and just didn’t really go away.

So I guess the period I’m talking about has been about a year and four months. Is that okay to say? I don’t want to make it sound like I’m exaggerating.
